TipCheck

Check a stock tip before you bet on it.

Michael Zheng · MGT 409 · AI Foundations for Managers · Fall 2026

Code (public repo): https://github.com/MichaelZ1212/tipcheck

The problem

$7.9Blost to investment scams in 2025, the #1 fraud category (FTC)
61%of investors under 35 use finfluencer tips (FINRA Foundation)

"Get in before Friday, it's the next Nvidia." Checking a tip properly takes skills and time most people don't have.

What's new

  • Starts from the tip itself and checks it claim by claim, not from a ticker
  • Bull vs Bear agents argue it out, then a Judge decides
  • Every number is checked in code against real data
  • Scam pressure and prompt injection are red flags, not orders
  • Never says buy or sell. Unlike ChatGPT, Perplexity Finance and Robinhood Cortex.

How the agents work

gpt-6-luna via Portkey · PydanticAI · tools: price vs S&P 500, valuation, SEC 10-K, news, calculator

Impact

“I usually wouldn't spend 15 minutes checking a stock tip. TipCheck makes it much easier to see what's actually true and what's just hype. I would definitely think twice before buying the stock.”

Vivian, a family member: 15 min by hand vs 2 min with TipCheck

A few cents per check against an average scam loss of $10,000+. Could be offered free by credit unions, libraries and financial-literacy programs.
